notes.title: Update 0.1.2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, here comes the first big update of IrreVRsible!

Here is the changelog:

- New Zombies
- Sniper Improved and has laser pointer
- Life is now displayed on the ground
- Difficulty curve has been smoothed
- Katana Physics has been Improved
- More Stable Ragdolls
- Various Minor bug fixes
